base_state.question: Why does every recursive function need a base case?

wrong.w_loop: treats recursion as a loop that ends on its own
wrong.w_speed: says the base case is only for speed

state.answer: The base case only makes it run faster; it would still work without one.
The base case stops the calls; without it the stack overflows.
